messages.subject: saved data
parts:
After running a qtl analysis, the summary(out.em) function gave an
output with a mix of data from both my analysis and another one (there
were markers included that were not mine). Aside from "remove all
objects" is there another way to remove all data that may have
previously been saved in R/qtl so that it does not interfere with new
data analyses?

Thanks!

messages.author: f388084a0de67b60
messages.subject: Re: saved data
parts:
I don't really understand what you mean; I don't see how
that could have happened. Could you give further details?
(This could be done privately, as perhaps not everyone on the
list wants to hear the details.)

To remove objects from your workspace, use the function rm().
To remove everything in your workspace, type rm(list=ls())

karl
